po_authorization_ref: Bounded correction pass on PR #22 against the stronger Fresh Production criterion. Repository-only. PR #22 is NOT merged; merge requires separate Product-Owner authorization.
previous_state_note: T0081 restored READY on the strength of a clean END STATE: the upgrade path created the superseded guest-IAM tables and 0049 removed them. Two acceptance issues were raised against that.
new_state_note: Both corrected. (1) A brand-new Production appliance is now built from a FACTORY-CLEAN BASELINE that never constructs the superseded guest-IAM tables at any point; proved by a DDL event trigger armed on the empty database before the first object exists, and the tripwire itself was checked by making it fire. The baseline is generated from the upgrade path's end state and the two catalogs are compared fact by fact, so they cannot drift. Migration 0049 is documented and treated as a destructive, non-reconstructive downgrade boundary whose rollback contract is a verified pre-upgrade backup restore, not DDL. (2) The licensed concurrent-guest cap was corrected to the authoritative scope -- PER APPLIANCE, resolved from the accepted implementation -- and made race-safe with a transaction advisory lock on the appliance id, with adversarial concurrency tests each verified by breaking the guarantee they protect.
corrections: FACTORY-CLEAN BASELINE: data-plane/migrations/baseline/0000_production_baseline.sql, generated by scripts/generate-production-baseline.sh and verified by scripts/factory-clean-baseline-verify.sh. A new appliance never constructs public.sessions, guests, guest_accounts, vouchers, voucher_batches, ticket_templates or payments. Migrations 0001-0049 are preserved as the upgrade path for existing installations.

LICENSED CAPACITY: reserveLicensedSlot in cmd/scd/iamv2_session_ops.go -- appliance-scoped count joined through iam_v2.devices, serialized by pg_advisory_xact_lock on the appliance id, called inside the same transaction that inserts the session. A non-positive limit means unlimited and takes no lock. Central availability plays no part; the limit comes from the signed licence on disk.
The per-entitlement device limit and all local-first licensing guarantees are unchanged.
defects_found_and_fixed: The 16-way stress test passed three consecutive runs with the advisory lock REMOVED: the admissions did not interleave at the instruction that matters. A test that cannot fail is not evidence, so a forced-interleaving test was added that holds two transactions open across the check-then-insert window.

pg_dump --no-privileges produced a baseline whose functions were all PUBLIC-executable, and Gate-P's D32 boundary assertion correctly refused the install. Privileges are now kept: the migrations REVOKE as well as create.
A schema-restricted pg_dump omits CREATE EXTENSION and never dumps roles, so the first baseline silently lacked pgcrypto, uuid-ossp, timescaledb and the five migration-created financial roles.

gatep-iam-roles.sql was order-dependent: its REFERENCES grant needs public.guest_networks, but the baseline's own privileges need the roles to exist first. The grant is now guarded and the file is order-independent.
